---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
billboard |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = song, color = artist)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Hits",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Song",
    color = "Artist"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
